name: Inverse Finance Anchor xINV InvFeed Keep3r TWAP manipulation
summary: Anchor priced xINV collateral via InvFeed, which read Keep3rV2Oracle.current(): a TWAP from the last observation of the SushiSwap INV/WETH pair, with no minimum window. The attacker pumped INV on Sushi and forced a fresh observation, then a block later minted xINV at the inflated price and borrowed ETH, WBTC, DOLA and YFI from Anchor markets.
notes: InvFeed and the Keep3r oracle predate xINV. The exploit also needed the Oracle's feed pointer for xINV and the comptroller listing xINV with a 60% collateral factor, set by governance nine blocks apart; the later collateral-factor write is the reset (rule 8).

The anchor is the borrow; the preceding 0x20a6dcff only pumped the Sushi pair and forced the Keep3r observation. About 170 calls to the attack contract's mint() by other EOAs in the next blocks borrowed nothing.
Loss is the four Borrow amounts; the INV the attacker left as collateral is not netted (rule 11), and xINV's routine INV reward pull from the timelock is not a loss.
